title: The Curse of Dependency for the Want of All Things

sense.text:
Let us make man in our image, after our likeness, and let them have dominion: So, what I want to stand out in this verse is a few things. One, image, likeness, and dominion. Image, likeness, and dominion. So remember those words as we read it again from the top.

Let us make man in our image: He says, "Let us make man after our image." What is he referring to? Tell me what does it mean? Make man in our own image. Meaning what? Is that what Ephesians 4:24 is talking about? First off, let me tell you it's the right precept, but I could tell you just have it written there. You wasn't really digesting what it means.

In our image: So, we were made after the image of God. Literally after his image. But it's more than just what you look like. Because back then, everybody was of color. So he's being specific because in that verse he says image, likeness and he said dominion. Not all nations had dominion. So everybody at that time were people of color. We didn't get that change until a little later on.

Let us make man in our own image: It's deeper than just the color of your skin. Because you got some black devils out here, too. Just because I said the white man, don't get fooled by that. You got some black people out here that's evil as hell.

Sidebar: Sidebar, I'mma talk about it real quick. How many young guys, young teenagers or young men that's 20 and under? By the show of hand, 20 and under. I'm trying to remember this guy's name. The little devil. Streamers. That little devil right there, they turn a generation of you young men into homosexuals. I'm telling you, do not watch that stuff. Them dudes is playing with Satan. I'm telling you. And I never knew how big the stuff was cuz I'm too old for that stuff to watch it. But they got a whole generation of young children watching stuff and it's all homosexual vibration. They're trying to turn you all out. Y'all know what I'm talking about, young people. Mind yourself. Be careful. Evil communication corrupt good manners. All right. I said my peace.

After our likeness: Let us make man after our image, after our likeness. Let's deal with the word likeness real quick.

After our likeness: When I said that when you read likeness, we at first go straight to his image, but it's more than just image. It's the character of a man that's abiding in the laws of God.

And let them have dominion over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth: It says that this man that's moving righteously, he was to have dominion over every animal, insect, bug, any living thing on earth. This righteous man was to have dominion or control over that. That was us at one time. There was nothing high in this earth over us and we traded it in because we saw seeking to do what the other nations doing. We're in these conditions based on our own doing and we have to accept the punishment that we're going through. And now as I'm talking it just irks me to my core is that I am dependent to nurse off of America to survive. It is humiliating anytime one of these nations talk slick to me. Oh gosh. I just be, Lord, I just keep these commandments and hold on. I just want payback.

Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: And subdue the earth. Listen what he says. I want you, after I'm making you after my likeness and image, to have dominion over earth. And then I want you to subdue. The word subdue is to bring under control everything. Everything that lives you subdue and put them under control and subdue it.

precepts.why: Let's go to Ephesians 4 real quick. That we put on the new man which after God is created in righteousness. That's the image. The image we're supposed to put on is the image of Christ and God being righteous. So he says, "Let us make man in our own image." It's deeper than just the color of your skin.

Let's deal with the word likeness real quick. Psalm 17. As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: That's that same word again we just read before with image, righteousness. When I awake with thy likeness: Thy likeness, thy image is when he said make man, I'm going to make man to be righteous. And then I'm going to give that man that I made to be righteous dominion over everything.

sense.text: But I'mma kind of go back before I get that far and say we lost it, man. Oh, we fumbled. We fumbled. We fumbled big time. We made such a big mistake and we're still paying for it. But Lord, the prophets are back on the earth and we trying, Lord. We the best you got. Just work with us and have mercy on us. But it hurts every time I read the scripture. It just bothers me.

He shall subdue the people under us: So let's deal with the subdue real quick. Give me Psalms. We're going to come right back here. Who is the us? God is going to subdue the people under the ones made after his likeness and his image and righteousness. That can only be us because the laws were only given to us. He has not dealt so with any other nation.

And the nations under our feet: So if you're confused what he's talking about, every creeping thing, every living thing, the nations are going to be subdued underneath us.

He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved: He said he shall choose our inheritance for us. The excellency of what? The excellency of Jacob is who God loved. That is the 12 tribes of Israel. That is the so-called Negroes, Hispanic, Native American Indians that are scattered throughout the earth. That's the Bible. That is the mission.

And the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground: Now, so the likeness and image was more than just complexion. It was righteousness. But here he's being specific about the color of the Israelites. And you know, we transcend all the shades of brown from as light as you can get it to as dark as you can get it. We're like a speckled bird, the Bible says.

And breathed into his nostrils the breath of life: And that breath of life is what was breathed into all nostrils. Give me that real quick. Wisdom of Solomon chapter 7 verse 24.

For wisdom is more moving than any motion: In Genesis 2 it said breath. Wisdom is found in everything you can think of. God's wisdom is in his creation of everything. The plants, the trees, the clothes we wear, everything. The hair on the head. It's God's wisdom. Him manipulating the elements to make man, to make tables, to make anything you could think of. Wisdom flows through everything.

She passeth and goeth through all things by reason of her pureness: Wisdom is found in all creations.

For she is the breath of the power of God: So when he breathed the breath of life into us, he breathed into us what? Wisdom, being made after his likeness. Cuz he is the embodiment of wisdom. And in that wisdom, now we have dominion, or we had dominion. We're not going to regain dominion until we first gain wisdom on how to move.

Why do I know that? Because if you give us power, the black people, dominion, I'm telling what we're going to do right now. We're going to do drugs. We're going to … We're going to steal. We're going to murder. Because we have no laws governing us. Without wisdom, we're shot. And you're not getting in the church. That you can forget that. That's a wrap. The church is a joke. You're not getting there. The only place you're going to find that is here. That's why they don't want to deal with us with this Bible because they know we going to read out this book. The same book they hold, we going to read out of this book. We can explain it without our words. We can explain it with God's words. That's why we dangerous.

Upon the sixth day thou gavest commandment unto the earth: So, real quick, in Second Esdras, they're explaining the creation that we read about in Genesis 1. I'm not going to start now, but when you have a chance, you can start in verse 38 on down and it gives you the same history.

And after these, Adam also, whom thou madest lord of all thy creatures: of him come we all: Now it's referring back to Adam. After these Adam also whom thou madest lord of all creatures. Lord, or have dominion of all creatures. Of him come we all. All people come out of Adam, all nations. So when he says like us being a shade of brown, well everybody was a shade of brown, but not everybody had wisdom. Not everybody had the breath of life in them. It was to Adam and the chosen that was coming. That's why I said you can't get around these scriptures. There's no other way to read this.

And the people also whom thou hast chosen: So he's being specific that everybody came out of Adam, but there's a special people that he chose that came from Adam. Is there another way to read this? It says what it says.

For I saw the desolation of Sion, and the wealth of them that dwelt at Babylon: How do you think Babylon got wealth? They took, they stole, they pillaged, they murdered. How do you think America got rich? How do you think Europe got rich?

And my spirit was sore moved, so that I began to speak words full of fear to the most High: So now watch this. He began to have this prayer, Ezra, after he saw the desolation of Zion and the wealth of Babylon. So he's there witnessing all that Babylon has. So if Babylon has the wealth and Jerusalem is destroyed, that means all people in poverty. And he sees this and he's saying, "Look Lord, you gave us everything and we lost it." So now to regain that, I want you to jump back one chapter.

And gavest a body unto Adam without soul: So prior to having the breath of life enter into him, he was a what? He gave us a body without a soul. I'm telling you, these other nations are soulless. They don't have a soul. I'm tell you something. They are zombies. They don't have a god. That's why they make gods with eight arms and a elephant trunk and all kind of what they doing. We the only people that have a god, a real true living God.

And did breathe into him the breath of life: So prior to that, Adam did not have life in him. It was a breath of life that entered into him. That's what makes us special, makes us unique. And right now, we're re-entering to that because when we lived at one time, we lived without a soul. We was soulless people committing all kind of sins. That's why the nations or the people are amazed when they see us move as a group because we have order, structure. Why is that? The laws of God. Because it wasn't laws of God, man. Imagine we trying to march out there with a thousand men. I'mma run a story real quick. "Go grab something to eat. Yo, yo, yo, go get some backwood so we can roll this up." We don't know how to act. We leave garbage in the street. It is the laws of God and we do it and it's second nature. That's the influence, the pure influence of God influencing us on how we move. It becomes second nature to our mind.

And he was made living before thee: So that's when we become alive, when we start applying these commands of life. Until then we're the walking dead.

Let me tell you something and I said this before. I'm going back to the young ones because I'm really trying to tap in with you young ones. We older and I hope you young ones are paying attention to me. You are the next generation to turn this thing upside down. Bro, I'm telling you, you are the ones. Y'all better get in the scriptures and get your mind right because the change is going to happen. It's always with the young ones. Y'all can stand on the corners for 12 hours. It's gonna be harder for a person my age to engage a young person to understand. But when they see you, these little YNC, you young ones out there teaching this. They just need direction. They're going to receive it. So we need you all to listen. I taught a class a while ago called Radicalize the Youth. You are the young ones that's going to make the difference. We're gonna set the stage for you, but y'all going to take this to the next level. You understand that, young men?

And unto him thou gavest commandment to love thy way: Okay, let me ask you a question. It said unto him thou gavest commandments to love thy way. What was the analogy he used in Genesis that he gave Abraham the commandments? What was the word he used? How did he give it to him in Genesis? The breath of life, right? Go up to verse five.

Of whom came nations, tribes, people, and kindreds out of number: Right? Out of Adam came everybody. But the point was, it says, And unto him thou gavest commandments to love thy way which he transgressed and immediately thou appointedst death in him. This was at one time we ruled. We became dependent. We went into Babylon. We went there and we needed Nebuchadnezzar to feed us. When we was in Egypt, we needed Pharaoh to feed us. I forgot that was number something, 12. I forgot what it was. Something about garlic and leaves. I think it's 6. I forgot. Anyway, don't worry about it. I'm thinking out loud. We were dependent. We saw the wealth of the nations and then we began to envy it when we had it.

These be they that have put off the mortal clothing: You got to put off this mortal clothing. The mortal clothing is sin. And attached to sin is all the cares of this world. You have to put off the mortal clothing.

And put on the immortal, and have confessed the name of God: And you have to confess the Lord's saviour Jesus Christ. But if we want to come out this dependent state, if we want to come out the state of look at the wealth of America, and you better not envy it, we got to put off this immoral clothing. This is the condition of the battle or we will stay dependent. We have to go to our enemies for the wants of all things. Job, housing, clothing, food, permission to drive, to get married, health care. There's nothing that Esau don't have his hand in. That's why he has a statement where it says the buck stops here, stops at his desk. We are just a conduit. It flows through. He gives us just enough so we can get by.

They have learned to flip the switch and flip the game. In slavery, they took us in, worked us, fed us so we can work whatever slot they gave us. If you was a good slave, they'll get you healthy. If you sick, they'll pay for that, take care of all that stuff to have you work. All they did was the money they spent to take care of you and feed you, they just said, "You know what? I'll make you free and just give you that same amount of money and a little bit less." That's why paycheck to paycheck surviving.

And for the ones of us that are better off financially, what you going to do? You can't live in a hood by your people cuz they going to rob you. And you can't go by Esau because they going to kill you. Well, they may kill the hood too. But you understand that point I'm saying: until we are in full rulership of dominion, it don't matter what we have here. We just pilgrims on earth surviving. You go make money and buy a nice house someplace and your neighbor don't want you there. He over there talking about you trying to kill your rose bush or whatever he doing.

Remember I moved someplace one time and I moved in. I'm like, I'm hoping there's Jake next to me, but I said, "Well, I hope they ain't Jake. I don't know if I want them." I was unsure because it was early in the morning and I saw a car in the front yard and it was a pickup truck. I'm like, no, this is an Esau. Then I went in the backyard and I saw three barbecue grills. I said, "Nah, he Jake." He had three barbecue grills. Jake do that.

And yet tookest thou not away from them a wicked heart: So this is the condition of the battle. Remember it says, "Put off the mortal clothing and put on the immortal clothing." Right? Watch this. God said, "I'm not going to take away from them that wicked heart."

That thy law might bring forth fruit in them: God said, "I'm not taking away your wicked heart from you. I want you to choose me. Everything you have, you were dependent on me." And you chose something else. Listen, it makes sense to me. I can understand why the Most High was angry with us. He said, "For all that I done for you, you telling me you think you had a better play? I made you a god on earth and you had dominion over everything and you still looked over there to the other nations. Well, you're going to go serve them." The white man gonna become your daddy.

You know how humiliating it is as a man that you have to go get social services to take care of your children, to feed your children. Now, I know we go through hard times. I get it. We find ourselves little paycheck. Can't make the bills. Got to go to the pawn shop. Pawn all stuff. You got those images going? It's humiliating. You think that's how we got to survive, about to pawn this TV to pay. 400% and fees add up. You know what it is to go there and porn? One time I had to do that. I had to pour in a ring to make a bill and I never was able to get the ring out. All those payday loans and all those pawn shops, it is set up to keep us like that. You already broke. You could afford these fees that they charging.

That thy law might bring forth fruit in them: Right? He says he's not going to take away that wicked heart because he wants us to choose him. He said, "I want to see my laws activate in your life." And when that happens, we will get dominion again. Until then, this is what we have and it's of our own doing.
Where are the benefits that I have done for you?: Look what the Lord said. That's a valid question. I can understand it. Lord said, "Where are the benefits for all that I've done for you?"

It had been better for us to have served the Egyptians, than to die in this wilderness: We are so shortsighted as people. That's how you got to hit right ahead, Cap. That's how you know we the people of this Bible. Like, who's this dumb? The power, Yahawah, the power parted the sea, killed the firstborn Egyptians. "Let us starve." We seeking to go back to Egypt where we were slaves at. That's like a lot of people here. They don't want to come out this captivity. They like it. Even poor, they like it. So once they get their little weed, their little drink, little … or whatever they doing, they buy into the system. We can't visualize ourselves as having the nations underneath us. We don't think that we're worthy enough. Well, I do. I don't suffer from that. That ain't my problem. I know where they belong. I'm just waiting. I'm all right with that. But he's asking, "Where's the benefits after all I've done for you?" And you're looking to go back that way.

Then had I pity upon your mournings, and gave you manna to eat; so ye did eat angels' bread: He said, "I fed you angel's bread. I gave you water. I gave you clothing. And you looking to go back?" It was me. The Lord said you depended on me. Now I'mma make your dependency a curse. I'll make you go depend on the nations. And then you're going to find people with no soul. No soul. They'll kill us in the street. They don't care. It means nothing to them. It moves on as regular everyday life.

What shall I do more for you? saith the Lord: The Lord said, "What else? I mean, what else more can I do for you?" I fed you. I gave you drink. I destroyed the nations out the land. Yeah, Lord. We are ungrateful people. That's what we are. He said, "You know what? There's nothing more I can do for you." Now you got to go serve your enemies. You got to go to them because they got to punish you and you're going to realize I was your best option. Really, I was your only option. But you thought you knew better.

But cast a tree in the water, and made the river sweet: Right? Because you know, … like Kool-Aid. I got to make it sweet for you diabetic. We couldn't drink regular water. It had been sweet, Lord. I need. Okay, here sweet water. And you still turn your back. We still turn them back on them. That's how I know we the people of the Bible also.
And the people also whom thou hast chosen: All right, let's drop that. I want to come back. And also the people whom you have chosen.

precepts.why: Give me Deuteronomy 7. He said he chose us to be a special people unto him. Special. I want you to look up the word special when you have a chance. But anyway, he says, "I chose you to be a special people unto the Lord, a chosen people above all nations." Above all nations. Above all nations. There's no equality in the Bible. It's just that we're on the wrong end of it. So, I understand why Esau thinks the way he thinks and other nations, they think they're better than us. Because we at one time knew we were better than them and they know that. That's why they steady trying to kill us off, trying to keep us in sin. Because once we reconnect with the word of God, our power activates real quick.

sense.text:
A peculiar people: That ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light: Right? He's called us out of darkness into his marvelous light. Now, watch this. I want you to read verse two.

As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word (1 Peter 2:2): That's the only way you're gonna become that peculiar people. You got to desire the sincere milk of the word. If this is not your desire, if this is not important to you, you're not going to be peculiar. That's what makes us. That's why you say, you know, "You guys are different. I can't put my finger on you. What is it about you guys?" It's God's, the breath of life that was breathed into us. That's why we move different. That's why we talk different. When you see 700 black people, you think they gonna talk about basketball and whatever they talking about. No. We on these cruisers, you see Carnival crew, they be brawling. Ratchet. Black people ratcheting. We go to cruise ship, we just sitting in the corner reading Bible. Why? We're not drinking. We're not smoking drugs. We're not stealing. We're not yelling, arguing. But they know, oh, there's something different about them.

That ye may grow thereby: You want to grow thereby.

How many been on the cruises before? I was asking, "What are you guys?" You know, "We're anthropologist." I don't know who came up with that one, but I love that. I don't know what an anthropologist is, bro. But that's what I am. Damn it. I'm an anthropologist. I was hoping somebody would ask me, "So, what's anthropologist?" Because I couldn't tell you. It's a scientist. God damn it. That's special, right?

Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts: That's what's going to make you a peculiar people because we're not trying to go to the strip club. I don't have an Only Fans. I can't speak for everybody else here. I know I don't have one. Okay, there was three people that don't have, rest of y'all nasty. They're lying. You … lying. Oh, you lying.

Which war against the soul: It wars against your soul. It destroys you. The laws of God is what makes us peculiar, different. Oh, they don't run to the same. What was that scripture? The same excess. I haven't used that in a while. Anybody remember?

precepts.why: What was that scripture? The same excess. I haven't used that in a while. Anybody remember? Thank you, Cap. Wherein they think it strange: They think it peculiar. That ye run not with them to the same excess of riot: Yeah, we don't do that. Gods don't do that. We're not looking around trying to figure out which sister we could sleep with. Real talk. Hey, you men. Who's single here? Single men. The sperm that's in your body that released from you is chosen sperm of God. You just don't plant that anywhere. You little nasty. That's to raise up a nation of royal priests. That's life that's inside of you. You just don't place it anywhere on any woman. That's disgusting. That's not how God's kings and priests move. We have to have that mentality that you find a woman worthy to lay down with. Not because she look good or whatever it might be. She has to have more attributes. Don't spread your seat all over the place like that. But in the world, we were like that. We didn't know better. That's what makes us peculiar. When we talk like that they're like, "Who's these dudes talking like that?" It's royal sperm. They don't understand what we talking about. But we're different.

sense.text: Above all the nations that are upon the earth: All right. Let's drop all that real quick. Chosen. We read Deuteronomy 7. It says it in Deuteronomy 14. Says it again. Above all the nation that are upon the earth. We are a holy people unto the Lord thy God. He hath chosen thee. We just read chosen in Second Esdras. We read chosen in Deuteronomy 7. We read in Peter's and we read again over and over again he's specifying that we are chosen. He chose us above everything. He said I met all these people but I'm choosing you. I'm putting the breath of life in you. You're the chosen people that I have. So if we're chosen that mean everybody else does not matter to him because he chose us, above all nations upon the face of the earth. Above all nations that are upon the earth, I should say. The Lord has shown us we're not the same. I chose you and the world was made for our sakes. Let's go back to that real quick.

Because thou madest the world for our sakes: You hear what he said? He said, the Lord, you made this world specifically fashioned for us. And until we are back in rulership, this earth will never run properly. You will have problems with the ozone, with the earth, with earthquakes, with tsunamis until the Israelites, the gods of the earth, are back in control. The world will not move properly. Listen, we are spiritually tethered to this earth because we're made from the dust of the ground. That's why this earth is so corrupt and falling apart now, is because the rightful ownership of it is not in our hands. But guess what? We gave it up.

Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be: Shall be your coast. Wherever your foot is, you put your foot there. That's why he said we made the earth. God, you made the earth for our sakes. So what do we decide we want is ours.

What's that black African always looking at the black woman behind? Johnson, a clown. Please. Those are the black thinkers? That dude doing an interview, he can't even control his neck. He's talking about whatever he's talking about. Afroentric, whatever. You ain't no leader, bro. One big old behind walked by and you just distracted. There was a time the nations dreaded us, afraid of us. But what are we now? Buffoons and clowns. I can almost argue say majority of the women that go on social media is half naked or they dancing or something like that. Where's the doctors? Where's a lawyer?

There shall no man be able to stand before you: That's why he said, and you go subdue the earth, cuz no nations could stand before us at one time.

For the Lord your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that ye shall tread upon: And that's how we're able to subdue them because they're going to be so afraid of us. They're not afraid of him now. Right now, I'm telling you something, Esau. Don't Jake fool you and think Esau is afraid of you. They know what Jake is doing. They go watch TikTok. I'm sorry. I'm going to say this word. All these … do dance and twerk. Listen, we're the black thinkers right now. I'm looking at them. This is it. There's nobody else. This the black thinkers. There's no other black thing. Oh, wait a second. LeBron James. Yeah, right. Please.

The fear of you and the dread of you: That's what I want. I want them to see me. I want them to be afraid. That's the power I want. I want that power, Lord. I want them when they see me, they stomach turn, they get irritable bowel syndrome. They see me, they even know what to do. Just to be in my presence.

Who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty Gods?: You see how the nations one time was worried? Who is going to deliver us from the hand? We were the gods they were worrying about.

These are the Gods that smote the Egyptians with all the plagues in the wilderness: These are the gods. They refer to us as gods. They knew what we were capable of doing when we was tapped in with God. That's why they make mockery of us now, because we're so dependent on them.

Be strong, and quit yourselves like men, O ye Philistines, that ye be not servants unto the Hebrews, as they have been to you: The word quit means to behave. Oh you Philistines, that you be not servants unto the Hebrews, as they have been to you. Quit yourself and be like men. Because at one time in the book of Judges, we were slaves and servants to all these other nations. Time and time again, we went into captivity. Time again. We are hard neck people.

And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the Lord; and they shall be afraid of thee: That was one of the blessings, that when they knew we were called the sons of God, by the name of the Lord, prince of the power, all the nations were afraid of us. Do you know on some level Esau still afraid of us? That's why they move the way they move. They're intimidated of us. And rightfully so. Cuz even us living this curse, we're still tapped in with God on some level. Our aura is what makes them uncomfortable. As much as they hate us, they want to be like us secretly. We were animals to them in slavery. Yet they wanted to sleep with our women. They want to dance like us. They want to tan their skin like us, put injections in their bodies to be like us. Here's the thing, and then we want to be like them. Boy, we … Oh, we …

As for the other people, which also come of Adam, thou hast said that they are nothing: God, you said they are nothing. God, this is God's word. He says, and the other people that have no soul, God said, you told us, God, they are nothing. Well, that makes sense of why they hate us. God said they are nothing to him. They hold no value.

But be like unto spittle: and hast likened the abundance of them unto a drop that falleth from a vessel: He said they're insignificant. They hold no value to him. They're like a drop that comes from a vessel. Means nothing. We are the apple of God's eye. That's why they drilled that St. John 3:16 in our minds. For God so loved the world that he gave his own begotten. I remember my grandmother used to. Oh God. Jimmy Swaggart used to play in my house. Never forget my grandmother, she had a little change, to Jimmy. Just send a little envelope to Jimmy Swaggart.

And when we say that, generally what we think about for the most part is we think about slavery here in America. I'mma say this and this is my opinion. Take this for what it's worth. I'm not going to diminish one to the other. But slavery here in America, Esau at that point understood, and in the Caribbean, it was for profit. The Spaniards now, they were sadistic. They was just killing. And not that Judah and the other tribes and suffering, but the Spaniards got to work. They got to work for real. They were working them and just killing them off and start to another island, work them to death, kill them off to go to another island. That's what they were, just the full genocide with them. By the time Esau, which is the so-called English man, he understood we need to keep some of them working because, you know, this is for profit. Spanish had a whole different mentality how they dealt with them.

These heathen, which have ever been reputed as nothing, have begun to be lords over us, and to devour us: They became lords over us. And to devour means to destroy us, to kill us off. Not just to be over us, but to kill us off. Devour means to destroy. They don't want us to survive. They don't want none of us left on this earth. If they could, they would kill us off.
